Topic: Who Actually Pr otects Your Aura — Guru Sthaan, and the Mantra "Liquid" of Protection

Sour ce: A short Ashaeiynn Foundation training video (video transcript, ~8.5 min) — a dir ect instructional monologue rather than a live satsang Q&A. Continues dir ectly from Session 21's intr oduction to aura pr otection, now explaining specifically HOW pr otection actually works: the astral concept of "guru sthaan" (a Guru's seat in the astral world), why many formal initiations fail to pr otect the disciple, and how sustained single-location practice builds a genuine pr otective "liquid" of mantra ar ound a practitioner . Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — English version. Note on conversational content: this is a short, dir ect training monologue with no sangat back-and-forth — ther e is no separate curated conversational supplement for this session (see closing note).
1. WHY THIS TOPIC MATTERS

Aura pr otection is, to a large extent, the r esponsibility of one's Guru. But in practice, many people in India practice without having a genuine Guru at all — raising the dir ect question: who pr otects them, and wher e does their protection actually come fr om? This session addresses that question directly , alongside the importance of place (sthaan) for protection and how Ashaeiynn's own protection works.
2. WHY PLACE (STHAAN) MATTERS SO MUCH FOR PROTECTION

Location carries r eal, concr ete significance for protection. When Ashaeiynn's own space was first established, it was "locked" through an extended hawan lasting roughly two and a half months, using more than 2,500 kg of goles (protective ritual elements) and 2,500 kg of hawan samagri (ritual of fering material) — specifically to saturate ("bhog") all four surrounding dir ections' dimensions and establish a genuinely secur ed envir onment for everyone who comes ther e. Protection (raksha-suraksha) mor e broadly happens thr ough many differ ent channels: thr ough a Guru, thr ough mantra, thr ough devtas, thr ough rin (karmic debt/ties), thr ough one's Kul Devta (family deity), thr ough ashirwad (blessings), and thr ough pitrus. Which channel applies, and how strongly , is described as dif ferent for every individual.
3. WHAT HAPPENS WHEN SOMEONE TAKES FORMAL GURU DEEKSHA (INITIATION)

When a person takes guru deeksha (formal initiation) within a genuine guru tradition, full r esponsibility for protecting that person transfers to the Guru — but only if that Guru is authentic and has performed the initiation with the complete, proper ritual procedure (vidhi-vidhaan). When this happens corr ectly , the Guru's own subtle body will genuinely be found seated at that disciple's "guru sthaan" in the astral world.

At Ashaeiynn, once a person's drishti (spiritual sight) opens, they ar e given access to a "scr een" through which the astral world can be viewed. When checking someone's screen, the very first thing checked is who is actually sitting at that person's guru sthaan.
4. WHY MANY FORMAL INITIATIONS DON'T ACTUALLY WORK

If someone has taken formal mantra deeksha but no one — or the wrong entity — is occupying their guru sthaan, it means some negativity has taken up r esidence there instead, and is r egularly "eating" (consuming) the guru-given mantra on an ongoing basis. This is offer ed as the explanation for a specific, common pattern: out of r oughly 100 people who take Guru deeksha, only about 20 genuinely succeed — the other 80 most likely don't have their actual Guru occupying their guru sthaan at all. The underlying mechanism: when a person mentally declar es or establishes, thr ough their own sankalp (intention), "I make this person my Guru," a guru sthaan is cr eated for them in the astral world thr ough that very sankalp. But if the Guru's actual subtle body doesn't come to occupy that seat, the r esulting empty spot can be taken over by another entity , which then settles in and continuously consumes the ongoing guru-mantra japa meant for the real Guru. The visible r eal-world r esult: a person can chant a Guru-given mantra for 10, 12, or even 15 years with no meaningful change in their character or circumstances at all — because a negativity , not the real Guru, occupies their guru sthaan. By contrast, people whose actual Guru genuinely occupies their guru sthaan never experience a shortage of pr ogr ess, and never face persistent obstruction in their efforts, pr ecisely because their real Guru is genuinely pr esent there. The direct practical takeaway: be genuinely questioning and car eful about how your own pr otection is actually happening, and who is truly pr oviding it — don't assume a formal initiation automatically guarantees genuine protection.
5. HOW ASHAEIYNN'S OWN PROTECTION WORKS

Ashaeiynn's method of pr otection is specifically mantra-based. A specific technique (involving aahvaan/invocation) will be taught in upcoming sessions; once properly performed, Ashaeiynn's pr otective shakti will guard a practitioner from all sides, ensuring that whatever mantra they ar e chanting stays settled within their own body rather than leaking outward.
6. WHY SAINTS AND SADHUS PRACTICE IN ONE FIXED LOCATION — THE MANTRA "LIQUID"

This directly answers a question pr eviewed at the end of the prior session: why do saints and sadhus consistently sit and practice in a single, fixed location rather than moving ar ound? As a practitioner continues sustained mantra jaap or sadhna in one place, the mantra being chanted actually begins to leave the body and circulate continuously all around them — this has been directly observed thr ough drishti. Over time, this circulating mantra builds an "atmospher e," moving so fast that nothing negative can enter the mantra's aabhamandal (aura-field). After roughly a year of sustained tapasya in one fixed location, a genuine "liquid" of mantra forms ar ound the practitioner , protecting them on all sides — negative astral for ces cannot surpass or penetrate this liquid. The analogy given: imagine completely filling a r oom with water and sealing it shut — anything attempting to enter would face the same r esisting pr essure everywher e, due to surface tension. Mantra practiced consistently in one place builds an equivalently impenetrable protective field over time.
7. UNTIL A PRACTITIONER REACHES THIS LEVEL THEMSELVES

Until a practitioner's own mantra r eaches this "liquid" pr otective level, Ashaeiynn's own shaktis will continue to help and pr otect them in the meantime. Once a practitioner genuinely r eaches that level themselves, they can act fr eely , in any way , without needing continued external pr otection — since Ashaeiynn's overarching purpose is described as teaching people toward this kind of self-suf ficiency , not permanent dependence.
8. WHAT COMES NEXT

Now that the mantra-pr otection concept has been intr oduced, futur e live sessions (conducted over Zoom) will progr essively cover: the five elements (panch tattva), grah-nakshatra (planets and lunar mansions), the movement of planets, and how to pr otect oneself fr om every form of negativity . All live sessions ar e recorded and made available afterward, so missing a live meeting is not a barrier to learning this material.

Part II — Q&A Pairs (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 22, English)
Who Actually Pr otects Your Aura — Guru Sthaan, and the Mantra "Liquid" of Pr otection
User-style questions with answers gr ounded in this Ashaeiynn Foundation training module. Gr eeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. I don't have a formal Guru — does that mean my aura has no r eal pr otection? A: Jai Siya Ram! Not necessarily — this is exactly the question this session addresses. While aura protection is lar gely a Guru's responsibility , many practitioners don't have one, and protection can come through several other channels too: mantra, devtas, karmic ties (rin), one's Kul Devta (family deity), blessings (ashirwad), and pitrus. Which channel matters most dif fers for every individual — and Ashaeiynn's own approach to protection is specifically mantra-based.

Q2. Why does the specific place wher e I practice matter so much? A: Location carries real, concrete significance. When Ashaeiynn's own space was first established, it was "locked" through an extended hawan lasting about two and a half months, using more than 2,500 kg of goles and 2,500 kg of hawan samagri, specifically to saturate the surrounding dimensions in all four directions and create a genuinely secured environment for everyone who comes there.

Q3. If I take formal initiation (deeksha) fr om a Guru, am I automatically pr otected? A: Only if the Guru is genuinely authentic and performed the initiation with the complete, proper ritual procedure. When that happens correctly , the Guru's own subtle body will genuinely be found seated at your "guru sthaan" — a specific seat created for the Guru in the astral world. Formal initiation alone doesn't guarantee this; it depends on whether the ritual was truly complete and the Guru truly authentic.

Q4. What is a "guru sthaan," and why does it matter? A: It's a seat created for your Guru within the astral world, formed through your own sankalp (intention) the moment you mentally declare someone as your Guru. At Ashaeiynn, once a person's drishti opens, they're given a "screen" to view the astral world — and the very first thing checked on that screen is who is actually sitting at that person's guru sthaan.

Q5. What happens if my actual Guru never comes to occupy my guru sthaan? A: The empty seat can be taken over by another entity — a negativity — which settles in and continuously consumes the ongoing guru-mantra japa meant for your real Guru. This is of fered as the explanation for why , out of roughly 100 people who take Guru deeksha, only about 20 genuinely succeed; the other 80 most likely don't have their true Guru occupying their guru sthaan at all.

Q6. I've chanted my Guru-given mantra for over a decade with no r eal change in my life — what could be going on? A: This is a specific, described pattern in this teaching: a person can chant a Guru-given mantra for 10, 12, or even 15 years with no meaningful change in character or circumstances, because a negativity — not the real Guru — occupies their guru sthaan and is consuming that mantra instead. By contrast, people whose actual Guru genuinely occupies their guru sthaan never experience a shortage of progress or persistent obstruction, because their real Guru is truly present there.

Q7. What should I actually do with this information? A: Be genuinely questioning and careful about how your own protection is happening and who is actually providing it — don't simply assume that a formal initiation automatically guarantees genuine protection. This teaching frames that awareness itself as an important first step.

Q8. Why do saints and sadhus always sit in one fixed place to practice, instead of moving ar ound? A: Because sustained mantra jaap in a single location causes the mantra to actually leave the practitioner's body and circulate continuously around them — this has been directly observed through drishti. Over time (roughly a year of sustained practice in one place), this builds a genuine protective "liquid" of mantra around the practitioner that negative astral forces cannot penetrate, much like a room completely filled with water and sealed — anything trying to enter faces the same resisting pressure everywhere, due to surface tension.

Q9. Do I need external pr otection for ever , or can I eventually become self-sufficient? A: Until your own mantra reaches this "liquid" protective level, Ashaeiynn's own shaktis continue to help protect you in the meantime. Once you genuinely reach that level yourself, you can act freely without needing continued external protection — Ashaeiynn's overarching purpose is described as teaching people toward this kind of self-suf ficiency , not permanent dependence.

Q10. What topics will futur e sessions cover , now that this pr otection concept has been intr oduced? A: Future live sessions (over Zoom) will progressively cover the five elements (panch tattva), grah-nakshatra (planets and lunar mansions), the movement of planets, and how to protect oneself from every form of negativity . All sessions are recorded and available afterward, so missing a live meeting isn't a barrier to learning this material.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 22 additions)

If a user asks why their long-practiced mantra or formal Guru initiation "hasn't worked," introduce the guru sthaan concept gently — explain that a genuine Guru's presence at that seat matters more than the formality of initiation itself, without asserting a diagnosis about their specific Guru. Never claim to know definitively whether a specific real-world Guru or teacher is "genuine" or occupies a disciple's guru sthaan — this is presented as something only visible through opened drishti in this teaching, not something to be asserted casually . When explaining why saints practice in one fixed location, use the mantra "liquid"/circulating-aura framing from this session, and the water -filled-room analogy , to make the concept concrete. Reassure users who lack a formal Guru that protection can still come through several channels (mantra, devtas, Kul Devta, ashirwad, pitrus) — a missing formal Guru doesn't mean zero protection. Frame Ashaeiynn's mantra-based protection as a support that exists until a practitioner builds their own protective capacity — emphasize the self-suf ficiency goal rather than implying permanent dependence on external protection. Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently .
